title: "12 snRNA Compare"
output: pdf_document

```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- SNRNA_COMPARE_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- SNRNA_COMPARE_TAB

prepare_module_outputs(
  OUTPUT_FIG_DIR,
  OUTPUT_TAB_DIR,
  c(
    "01_composition",
    "02_sequence_landscape",
    "03_length_distribution",
    "04_sample_qc",
    "05_top_sequences"
  )
)

activate_serum_context(environment(), analysis_scope = "method_comparison")
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- length(pandora_group_n) >= 2L && all(pandora_group_n >= 2L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

```{r build-snrna-inputs, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare", eval=TRUE}
snrna_sample_total <- sample_comp_view %>%
  filter(as.character(MainCategory) == "snRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

snrna_group_total <- snrna_sample_total %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("MainCategory") %>%
  left_join(group_clean_reads_tbl, by = "Group") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

# 本模块的详细对象以唯一序列计数；完整注释仅作标签，不拆 token 分配 reads。
snrna_detail <- output_all %>%
  filter(
    FeatureCategory == "snRNA",
    !is.na(Sequence),
    Sequence != "",
    !is.na(PrimaryAnnotation),
    PrimaryAnnotation != "",
    PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
    FullAnnotation = as.character(Annotation),
    AnnotationContext = if_else(as.character(Annotation) == "snRNA", "snRNA_only", "snRNA_with_other_annotation")
  )

snrna_sequence_sample <- snrna_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Sequence, Length, AnnotationContext) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), RPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(Percent = group_percent(Reads)) %>%
  ungroup()

snrna_sequence_group <- snrna_sequence_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_rpm(c("Sequence", "Length", "AnnotationContext")) %>%
  left_join(
    snrna_sequence_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent(c("Sequence", "Length", "AnnotationContext")) %>%
      select(Group, Sequence, Length, AnnotationContext, Percent),
    by = c("Group", "Sequence", "Length", "AnnotationContext")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = replace_na(Percent, 0),
    SequenceLabel = paste0(Sequence, " (", Length, " nt)")
  )

snrna_context_sample <- snrna_sequence_sample %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, AnnotationContext) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), SequenceCount = n_distinct(Sequence), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  mutate(ReadPercent = group_percent(Reads), SequencePercent = group_percent(SequenceCount)) %>%
  ungroup()

snrna_context_group <- snrna_context_sample %>%
  summarise_group_mean_percent("AnnotationContext", percent_col = "ReadPercent") %>%
  select(Group, AnnotationContext, Reads, ReadPercent = Percent) %>%
  left_join(
    snrna_context_sample %>%
      summarise_group_mean_percent("AnnotationContext", percent_col = "SequencePercent", reads_col = "SequenceCount") %>%
      select(Group, AnnotationContext, SequenceCount = Reads, SequencePercent = Percent),
    by = c("Group", "AnnotationContext")
  )

snrna_length_group <- group_length_view %>%
  filter(MainCategory == "snRNA") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels))

snrna_length_peak <- snrna_length_group %>%
  filter(RPM > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = RPM, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(Group, PeakLength = Length, PeakRPM = RPM, PeakReads = Reads)

snrna_sample_detection <- snrna_detail %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    DetectedSnRNASequences = n_distinct(Sequence),
    SnRNAReads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(clean_reads_tbl, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    SnRNAReadFraction = if_else(CleanReads > 0, 100 * SnRNAReads / CleanReads, 0),
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)
  )

snrna_top_sequences <- snrna_sequence_group %>%
  filter(RPM > 0 | Reads > 0) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = RPM, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

snrna_top_sequences_overall <- snrna_sequence_group %>%
  group_by(Sequence, Length, SequenceLabel) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), Sequence) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

snrna_alluvial_top_map <- snrna_sequence_group %>%
  group_by(Sequence, Length) %>%
  summarise(TotalRPM = sum(RPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalRPM), Sequence) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    ShortSequence = if_else(nchar(Sequence) > 18, paste0(substr(Sequence, 1, 18), "..."), Sequence),
    TrendCategory = sprintf("S%02d: %s (%s nt)", row_number(), ShortSequence, Length)
  )

snrna_alluvial_levels <- c(snrna_alluvial_top_map$TrendCategory, "Other snRNA sequences")

snrna_alluvial_sequence_map <- snrna_alluvial_top_map %>%
  select(TrendCategory, Sequence, Length, TotalRPM)

snrna_sequence_alluvial <- snrna_sequence_group %>%
  left_join(
    snrna_alluvial_top_map %>% select(Sequence, Length, TrendCategory),
    by = c("Sequence", "Length")
  ) %>%
  mutate(TrendCategory = replace_na(TrendCategory, "Other snRNA sequences")) %>%
  group_by(Group, TrendCategory) %>%
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads, na.rm = TRUE), Percent = sum(Percent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels),
    TrendCategory = factor(TrendCategory, levels = snrna_alluvial_levels)
  )

snrna_alluvial_palette <- setNames(
  c(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(max(length(snrna_alluvial_top_map$TrendCategory), 1), palette = "Set 3"),
    serum_neutral_line
  )[seq_along(snrna_alluvial_levels)],
  snrna_alluvial_levels
)

snrna_feature_matrix <- build_feature_count_matrix(
  snrna_detail,
  feature_col = "Sequence",
  sample_order = as.character(sample_info$Sample),
  feature_order = snrna_top_sequences_overall$Sequence,
  min_total = 0
)

snrna_correlation_tbl <- tibble()
if (nrow(snrna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2 && ncol(snrna_feature_matrix$matrix) >= 2) {
  snrna_cor <- cor(log2(snrna_feature_matrix$matrix + 1), method = "pearson")
  snrna_cor_order <- rownames(snrna_cor)
  if (nrow(snrna_cor) > 1) {
    snrna_cor_order <- rownames(snrna_cor)[hclust(as.dist(1 - snrna_cor), method = "complete")$order]
  }
  snrna_correlation_tbl <- expand.grid(sample_x = snrna_cor_order, sample_y = snrna_cor_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  snrna_correlation_tbl$correlation <- as.vector(snrna_cor[snrna_cor_order, snrna_cor_order])
}
```

```{r snrna-composition, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(snrna_group_total) > 0) {
  snrna_total_plot <- build_two_group_summary_bar(
    snrna_sample_total,
    "Percent",
    "snRNA abundance across groups",
    "Mean percent of clean reads per sample",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = group_palette,
    sample_info = sample_info,
    label_digits = 1
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    snrna_total_plot,
    "01_composition",
    "snrna_group_total_percent.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

snrna_sample_percent_plot <- ggplot(snrna_sample_detection, aes(x = Sample, y = SnRNAReadFraction, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", SnRNAReadFraction)), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "snRNA fraction per sample", x = NULL, y = "Percent of clean reads") +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())

save_plot_nested(
  snrna_sample_percent_plot,
  "01_composition",
  "snrna_sample_total_percent.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 5.2,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r snrna-sequence-landscape, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(snrna_context_group) > 0) {
  context_palette <- c(snRNA_only = serum_blue, snRNA_with_other_annotation = serum_orange)

  context_read_plot <- ggplot(
    snrna_context_group %>% mutate(AnnotationContext = factor(AnnotationContext, levels = names(context_palette))),
    aes(x = Group, y = ReadPercent, fill = AnnotationContext)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = context_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x = "Group",
      y = "Percent of snRNA reads",
      title = "snRNA-only versus co-annotated snRNA reads",
      fill = "Annotation context"
    ) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  save_plot_nested(
    context_read_plot,
    "02_sequence_landscape",
    "snrna_annotation_context_read_percent.pdf",
    width = 8,
    height = 5.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

top_sequence_heatmap_df <- snrna_sequence_group %>%
  filter(Sequence %in% snrna_top_sequences_overall$Sequence) %>%
  mutate(
    SequenceLabel = factor(SequenceLabel, levels = rev(snrna_top_sequences_overall$SequenceLabel)),
    Group = factor(as.character(Group), levels = group_levels)
  )

if (nrow(top_sequence_heatmap_df) > 0) {
  top_sequence_heatmap <- ggplot(top_sequence_heatmap_df, aes(x = Group, y = SequenceLabel, fill = log2(RPM + 1))) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#f7fbff", "#6baed6", "#08306b"), na.value = "#e5e7eb") +
    labs(x = "Group", y = NULL, fill = "log2(RPM+1)", title = "Top snRNA sequences across groups") +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

  save_plot_nested(
    top_sequence_heatmap,
    "02_sequence_landscape",
    "snrna_top_sequence_heatmap.pdf",
    width = 9,
    height = 8,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

if (nrow(snrna_sequence_alluvial) > 0) {
  snrna_sequence_alluvial_plot <- build_trend_alluvial_plot(
    snrna_sequence_alluvial,
    snrna_alluvial_levels,
    "Percent",
    "Alluvial plot of top snRNA sequences across groups",
    "Proportion within snRNA reads (%)",
    group_levels,
    fill_palette = snrna_alluvial_palette
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    snrna_sequence_alluvial_plot,
    "02_sequence_landscape",
    "snrna_top_sequence_percent_alluvial.pdf",
    width = 11,
    height = 6.5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r snrna-length, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(snrna_length_group) > 0) {
  snrna_length_line <- ggplot(snrna_length_group %>% filter(RPM > 0), aes(x = Length, y = RPM, color = Group, group = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    sncrna_length_axis() +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  snrna_length_bar <- ggplot(snrna_length_group %>% filter(RPM > 0), aes(x = factor(Length), y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.74), width = 0.68) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Length (nt)", y = "RPM", title = NULL) +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  snrna_length_plot <- build_plot_collage(
    list(snrna_length_line, snrna_length_bar),
    title_text = "snRNA length comparison across groups",
    cols = 1
  )

  save_plot_nested(
    snrna_length_plot,
    "03_length_distribution",
    "snrna_length_compare.pdf",
    width = 9,
    height = 10,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

if (nrow(snrna_length_peak) > 0) {
  snrna_peak_plot <- ggplot(snrna_length_peak, aes(x = Group, y = PeakLength, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.68, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(PeakLength, " nt")), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Dominant snRNA length per group", x = "Group", y = "Peak length (nt)") +
    serum_theme_bw()

  save_plot_nested(
    snrna_peak_plot,
    "03_length_distribution",
    "snrna_peak_length_by_group.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 5.2,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}
```

```{r snrna-sample-qc, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(snrna_correlation_tbl) > 0) {
  snrna_cor_values <- snrna_correlation_tbl$correlation[is.finite(snrna_correlation_tbl$correlation)]
  snrna_cor_min <- if (length(snrna_cor_values) > 0) min(snrna_cor_values) else 0
  if (!is.finite(snrna_cor_min) || snrna_cor_min >= 1) snrna_cor_min <- 0.95

  snrna_cor_plot <- ggplot(snrna_correlation_tbl, aes(sample_x, sample_y, fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.finite(correlation), sprintf("%.2f", correlation), "")), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = serum_diverging_palette,
      limits = c(snrna_cor_min, 1),
      na.value = serum_neutral_line
    ) +
    labs(title = "Sample correlation from top snRNA sequences", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Pearson r") +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  save_plot_nested(
    snrna_cor_plot,
    "04_sample_qc",
    "snrna_sample_correlation_heatmap.pdf",
    width = 7.5,
    height = 6.5,
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

snrna_detection_plot <- ggplot(snrna_sample_detection, aes(x = Sample, y = DetectedSnRNASequences, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label = DetectedSnRNASequences), vjust = -0.35, size = 3.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Detected snRNA sequences per sample", x = NULL, y = "Number of detected snRNA sequences") +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())

save_plot_nested(
  snrna_detection_plot,
  "04_sample_qc",
  "snrna_detected_sequences.pdf",
  width = 9,
  height = 5.2,
  view = REPORT_VIEW
)
```

```{r snrna-top-sequences, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="describe", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "describe"}
if (nrow(snrna_top_sequences) > 0) {
  sequence_order <- snrna_top_sequences %>%
    arrange(desc(RPM), SequenceLabel) %>%
    distinct(SequenceLabel) %>%
    pull(SequenceLabel)
  snrna_top_sequences <- snrna_top_sequences %>%
    mutate(SequenceLabel = factor(SequenceLabel, levels = rev(sequence_order)))

  snrna_top_plot <- ggplot(snrna_top_sequences, aes(x = SequenceLabel, y = RPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, position = position_dodge(width = 0.78)) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~Group, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Top snRNA sequences per group", x = NULL, y = "RPM") +
    serum_theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

  save_plot_nested(
    snrna_top_plot,
    "05_top_sequences",
    "snrna_top_sequences.pdf",
    width = 11,
    height = max(8, 3 * n_distinct(snrna_top_sequences$Group)),
    view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
}

write_csv_safe(snrna_detail %>% select(Sample, Group, Sequence, Length, Reads, RPM, FullAnnotation, AnnotationContext),
               "snrna_sequence_annotations.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_group_total, "snrna_group_total.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_context_group, "snrna_annotation_context_group.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_alluvial_sequence_map, "snrna_alluvial_sequence_map.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_sequence_alluvial, "snrna_sequence_alluvial.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_sequence_group, "snrna_sequence_group.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_sample_detection, "snrna_sample_detection.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_length_group, "snrna_length_group.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_length_peak, "snrna_length_peak.csv")
write_csv_safe(snrna_top_sequences, "snrna_top_sequences.csv")
```

snRNA analysis completed.
